_comment: Theme presets for the parametric graphic templates ({{theme.*}} placeholders). scripts/render-graphic.py --surface <name> merges the preset over data.theme. `dark` is the original proposal surface (slides, pitch decks, HTML review); `light` is the Word-page surface (2026-09-04) for figures embedded in a .docx. Tokens mirror my-company/branding/proposal-graphics.css and proposal-graphics-light.css.
